facts: Some dogs can smell dead bodies under water, where termites are hiding, and natural gas buried under 40 feet of dirt. They can even detect cancer that is too small to be detected by a doctor and can find lung cancer by sniffing a person’s breath.
Cerberus was the tri-headed dog that guarded the underworld in Greek mythology.
The normal body temperature of a dog is 100.94 degrees Fahrenheit (38.3 Celsius) to 102.56 F (39.2 C) whereas human normal body temperature 98.6 F (37 C).
Dogs normally have between one to sixteen or even more puppies.
The world's largest dog was a Great Dane named Zorba, who weighed 343 pounds.
